notes: Governing documents: the UC systemwide APM 760, 710, 715, 133 and 220, and the campus Provost Directive 03-006 (2003), which the December 2017 campus Work Life page cites as the basis of the campus program. The campus page, FAQ and brochure are summaries; details taken only from them (time windows, dual-faculty rules, two-event limits, regular monthly salary during the campus leave) are marked in the components.

V3c (campus and system): the campus program (one quarter of paid childbearing leave c1, one quarter of ASMD c3) and APM 760 (6 weeks paid within the childbearing leave c5, and a two-quarter total of childbearing leave plus ASMD for a birth mother c6) provide the same benefits. They are linked so that neither adds: c1 within c6; c3 consecutive_after c1 and concurrent_with c6. The FAQ describes the choice between a quarter of leave and 'six weeks of leave and then ASMD for the remainder of the quarter', both followed by a further ASMD quarter; both fall within the APM two-quarter envelope.

Calendar: quarters (UC Davis); kind of term stated, length not, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. Quarter alternatives coded where the APM says 'quarter (or semester)'.

Chain, birth parent: childbearing leave / PDL up to 4 months (c4) from the birth, with FMLA (c8) alongside, the 6 weeks' pay (c5) within c4 and the campus paid quarter (c1) from the birth; c1 and c4 lie within the APM ASMD envelope of two quarters (c6) → campus ASMD quarter (c3) after c1 → CFRA 12 workweeks (c9) after c4 (S1a) → parental leave without pay up to one year (c7) after c4, with CFRA alongside; APM 710 medical leave (c11, pay c12 within) also available, then unpaid medical leave (c13); everything capped at one year for the event (leave_limits).

Chain, non-birth parent: APM ASMD one quarter (c6) with the campus ASMD quarter (c3) concurrent; parental leave without pay up to one year (c7) with FMLA (c8) and CFRA (c9) concurrent; discretionary paid FMLA (c10) within FMLA; capped at one year.
Discretionary paid FMLA (c10, APM 715-20-b) applies to faculty because faculty do not accrue sick leave (APM 710-0-a); the FAQ says paid leave for a father is 'not guaranteed'.

Statutes: FMLA, CFRA and PDL verified against the saved statute texts (2026 captures; the 12-workweek and four-month lengths and the PDL-additional clause are the operative terms). FEHA beyond PDL and the Workers' Compensation Act are listed under C4 as not components.

Other groups recorded: non-Senate academic appointees (c22), HSCP faculty (c23), non-faculty academic appointees who accrue sick leave (c24), fiscal-year faculty (c25). Non-faculty ASMD pay reduction (APM 760-28-b(2)) and non-Senate leave without pay (760-25-b(4)) are noted in descriptions only.

Documents cited but not saved: APM 730 (Vacation), APM 758 (Other Leaves with Pay), APM 759 (Other Leaves without Pay), APM 700, 711, 720, 740, 750, 751, 752, 765, APM 110-15, 145, 150, 080, 210-1, 670; the UC Short-Term Disability and Supplemental Disability plan documents; HSCP School Implementation Procedures and campus policies; Unit 17 and Unit 18 MOUs; the Request for Teaching Release form; the SOM Worklife Program; UC Davis PPM; the Work Life Resource Card; the 2013-14 Annual Call.
C6 (general leaves): the leaves page says 'Other leaves with pay or leaves without pay may also be granted' under APM 758 and 759, which are not saved; no terms, so no component.
